summary: Read a model release as a set of inspectable design and evidence claims rather than a permanent ranking.
outcomes: Separate architecture, training, capabilities and deployment claims
Compare evaluation conditions and distinguish unknown from disclosed facts
sequence: Identify release date and source artifacts
Map reported scores to evaluation protocols
Compare licenses and intended-use statements without guessing

visual.question: Are these reported model scores measuring the same conditions?
visual.interaction: Toggle benchmark settings, tool access and inference budgets

practice.task: Compare two historical model reports on one task
practice.success: Every factual claim has a dated primary source and incompatible scores remain unranked
